errors.evidence: The value for the "Ost" line in 2019 is approximately 6.9, not 6.95. The data point is very close to the 6.9 grid line.

errors.text_span: fällt im Jahr 2021 auf einen Tiefstpunkt von etwa 6,5 ab
errors.evidence: The value for the "Ost" line in 2021 is clearly below 6.5, at approximately 6.45. Stating it is at 6.5 is an overestimation and factually incorrect.
